scores.evidence: Three can-do objectives with Bloom levels: o1 analyze, o2 apply, o3 analyze. Each is assessed at least twice outside the ungraded q0: o1 by q1, q2, e1 and e2; o2 by q3 (apply), e3 (apply, transfer to `~/.aws/`) and e4; o3 by q4, e5 and e6. lessons:lint --strict reports 0 warnings.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「知らないリポジトリをcloneし…」「`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` が残っています」) and then asks 「何が起こりうるでしょうか。」. The predict question q0 is a multi-select, and its explanation points ahead to 10-1, 10-2 and 10-5. There is no trivia or statistics.

Prerequisites list 第2回 and 第5回 through 第9回. New terms are defined before use: プロンプトインジェクション in s1-defs, VM glossed in s1-practices, ワークスペースの信頼 and サンドボックス in s2-defs, クラウドセッション inline in s2-isolate, エフォート in s5-md2 before s5-table. A few terms are never explained: `/status` (s5-table, e5, practice), `--bare` (s2-isolate) and Console (e5).

measure.mjs gives 「prose 1887 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」, and lint is clean. Every segment ends with a table, diagram or check. s2 is at the 3-new-term limit and also brings in Seatbelt, bubblewrap and `--bare`. The second paragraph of s5-md2 strings three unrelated asides together (`-p` and the key, `/clear` versus `/compact`, the definition of エフォート).

s3-steps is a worked example with 4 labelled subgoals, each with an expect, followed by s3-code and then q3. p-deny applies the same form to `.env` and `secrets/` (hint 「10-3の `keys/**` と同じ形です。」). ex-target gives no reason, and the audit and bill parts of the practice have no worked example besides the lookup tables.

Inline checks follow s1, s2, s3 and s5; only s4 has none, so there are never 2 content sections in a row without a check. q1 (`curl … | bash` from a web page), q3 (`certs/**`) and q4 (Pro limit after chat use) are application scenarios. q2 (「知らない人の公開リポジトリを試したいとき、公式ドキュメントが勧める方法」) can be answered by looking up s2-table row 2 just above it.

Every wrong option has feedback of at most 2 sentences that names a real misconception and gives the reason. For example, q1-d 「CLAUDE.mdは助言で、強制ではありません」, q2-b sandbox scope, q3-d `.claudeignore`, e3-b single `/`, e5-b 「`/usage` の金額は手元の見積もり」 and e6-a 「`/compact` は…それ自体が大きな要求」. These match the brief's misconception list 1–7.

Re-scored because s2-table changed. The table still has 2 columns. The new row 3 cell (「強い権限（`bypassPermissions`）：拒否ルールで止めた操作のほかは、ほぼ確認なしで動く」) is a few characters longer but is still one clause that fits a mobile column, and its column 2 cell is unchanged. The s2-layers issues are unchanged: the caption 「VMやクラウドセッションはClaude Code全体を…囲みます」 describes a layer that is not drawn, and the edge label 「サンドボックスの中」 hides 「既定はオフです」 (s2-defs).

Unchanged since the previous round. practice-steps-deny's expect 「Claudeの読み取りが拒否され、`/permissions` にルールが出ます。」 is observable and matches practice-prompt-read's expect 「拒否ルールのため読めなかったと答えます」. There is an authentic audit of 田中さん's setup, a 4-item checklist and model answers. The hint ladder is still shallow (p-audit has one hint, and p-bill's troubleshoot gives the answer), and practice-case-habits still says 「`.env` と `secrets/` に拒否ルールがない」 outright.

The summary section comes after the exam. It has 3 points, a reflection question (「自分の環境で、田中さんと同じ状態になっているものはありますか。」), a next step to 第11回, 7 flashcards that each test a distinct point (for example card-clear and card-usage), and askTutor suggestions.

Re-scored because s2-table changed. Row 3 now reads 「拒否ルールで止めた操作のほかは、ほぼ確認なしで動く」. This says that deny-ruled actions are stopped, not prompted, and so removes the misreading that the previous niceToHave and the audit raised about 「拒否ルール以外は」. It matches reports/facts/cc-10-safety-cost.facts.md [safety-1] 'Deny rules still block in every mode, including bypassPermissions', and 「ほぼ」 covers [safety-14] (explicit ask rules and critical-path rm/rmdir still stop). It agrees with the glossary entry 拒否ルール and with e4's feedback 「拒否ルールは、どの権限モードでも効きます。」. The block still cites cc-permission-modes. The audit's dropped finding carries a matching laterChanged note (reports/facts/cc-10-safety-cost.audit.json).

Re-scored because s2-table changed. The new cell is plain and calm, です・ます is not needed in a table cell, and the glossary term 拒否ルール is used consistently. 「止めた操作」 matches the lesson's verb elsewhere (q1-d 「拒否ルールで止めます」). The offline case is still worded three ways: 「オフラインのコンテナかVMだけで使う」 (s2-table, unchanged column), 「ネットにつながらないコンテナやVMの中で使う」 (e2-b) and 「ネットにつながらない隔離環境」 (e1-b).

The only locale is jp. Link texts are descriptive (「セキュリティの公式ドキュメント」, 「公式の料金ページ」). The diagram labels are Japanese and s2-layers has full alt text. Plain-text fields (checklist labels, var hints, captions) avoid markdown. The alt describes a VM enclosure that the diagram does not draw.

niceToHave: Still open from earlier rounds (unchanged blocks): make s2-check q2 a scenario instead of a lookup in s2-table row 2; make check-quiz e6 test the cause in line with o3; fix the s2-layers caption, alt and edge 「サンドボックスの中」 (for example 「サンドボックス（オン時）の中」); explain `/status` in s5-table row 1; spread the s5-md2 asides into their table rows; make practice-case-habits a neutral observation (「プロジェクトに `.env` と `secrets/` があり、`.claude/settings.json` は置いていない」); add `cd ~` as the first line of practice-folder; give ex-target a reason; use one phrase for the offline case across s2-table, e1-b, e2-b and practice-prompt-review ①.
summary: Verification round. review-scope.mjs exited 0: 1 of 44 blocks changed (s2-table row 3), and the previous review had no open must-fix items. The new wording 「拒否ルールで止めた操作のほかは、ほぼ確認なしで動く」 is correct and cited ([safety-1], [safety-14]). It removes the misreading noted in the previous niceToHave, so that item is dropped. Visual, accuracy and voice were re-scored and are unchanged at 3, 4 and 3. validate and lint --strict are clean. measure.mjs gives prose 1887 and est 17.3 min, which matches estMinutes 17. No regressions were found.
